newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bond market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bond market closing report.

text.p: Swiss bond prices ended firm but below day's highs after release of U.S. economic data.
U.S. March producer prices rose 0.4 percent in the core rate, while the overall number fell 0.1 percent.
U.S. March retail sales, excluding autos, rose 0.5 percent compared with a forecast for a 0.4 percent gain.
U.S. and German bond prices were lower after the data.

The June Swiss Conf futures contract was up slightly at the close but below the 117.65 high set before the U.S. numbers. One trader saw support for the Conf at 117.40, which was right at the level where the June Conf closed.
Swiss money rates were seen mixed with the Swiss franc's strength nudging short-term rates lower.
Conf futures CONFc1 up five at 117.40.
Comi medium-term bond* COMIc1 settles at 110.73
(*quoted price only versus 110.95 at Thursday close)
Euro Swiss francs FESc1 down one at 98.03.
